config.title: FUNDA — Parallel API Dashboard Card

intro.title: FUNDA — Parallel API Dashboard Card
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Parallel API Dashboard Card — a stats widget that simultaneously fetches data from three different API endpoints (user count, revenue total, and active sessions) and renders a composite card once all data is ready, with per-source error handling that shows a partial result if one API fails rather than blanking the entire card. You will use forkJoin with individual catchError wrappers for fault tolerance, model the card's state using NgRx ComponentStore as a local state container, and animate the count values from 0 to their final values on first load.
intro.usecase: Analytics dashboards, executive summary cards, and KPI widgets aggregate data from multiple backend services simultaneously. The correct implementation uses parallel requests with forkJoin and degrades gracefully when individual sources fail.

objectives: Fire three HTTP requests in parallel using forkJoin with an object notation so results are labelled rather than positional
Wrap each individual source in catchError(() => of(null)) so a single failure does not kill the entire forkJoin
Detect partial results in the subscriber and render a degraded card state (greyed-out stat) when a source returned null
Set up NgRx ComponentStore with a typed DashboardState interface and implement updater methods for each data source
Create selectors using ComponentStore.select() to derive loading, error, and individual stat values from the store state
Animate each stat counter from 0 to its final value on first render using an Angular Animation or a custom RxJS timer sequence
Add a refresh button that re-fires all three requests and uses the ComponentStore's patchState to reset loading state before the new fetch
